meta.title: A Note on the Fridge
meta.textType: a note from family or a friend

paragraphs: Dear Lily and Tom. Good morning! It is a cool, bright morning. Dad and I left early today to visit Grandma and Grandpa in Green Hill. We will help Grandpa in the garden, and we will come home at six o'clock. Please read this note before you go to school. Can you do some small things for me?

Breakfast is on the kitchen table: rice, eggs, and fruit. The eggs are still warm. Please eat it all, because it is a long school day. There is also a small bag of cookies for the break. Tom, please do not eat Lily's cookies. Pip had his food, but he needs fresh water in his bowl. Tom, please give him the water before you leave.

Lily, the club flag is in the hall closet, in the pale blue bag. Teacher Kim wants it for the club meeting after lunch. The bag is easy to find. It is the green flag with the paw print, the sign of the Explorers. Please carry it with both hands, because the pole is long. Do not put it on the wet ground. I read your latest article for the Explorers' Blog last night. I especially liked the end, because it made me smile.

Tom, you are the key keeper today. The back door key is on the hook next to the fridge. It is the silver key, not the old brown key. Please lock the door when you leave, and put the key in your pocket. Do not lose it, because we have only one silver key. You will come home first, because your lessons end at a quarter to three. Please open the door for Lily when she comes home.

I am sure that you will do everything well. Pip will be happy. I love you both. Aunt Sue will call at seven o'clock tonight, so please stay near the phone. She wants to hear about your day. Pip needs a short walk in the park after school. Please take him together, and give him a little water after the walk. Have a good day at school. With love, Mom.
text.summary: Mom leaves a note on the fridge for Lily and Tom. She tells Lily about the club flag and the blog article, and she tells Tom about the silver key.
